requiredActions: Replace the native <select>-based ScopeSwitcher (src/components/chrome.tsx) with the DLS ScopePill primitive (pill button + anchored menu, Figma 6588:16960, 8px corner radius per direct instruction rather than the Figma node's full rounding); ScopeSwitcherVM props are unchanged.

Add icon.insights.scope-avatar (Remix user-line placeholder) as public/icons/scope-avatar.svg + MANIFEST.json entry + scripts/copy-icons.mjs mapping; prefix the pill with it at every breakpoint, using the same single-person icon regardless of the current scope.

Extend ScopePill (src/dls-stub/index.tsx) with optional icon/ariaLabel props and a .scope-pill-label span that stays in the DOM at every breakpoint; hide it via CSS below breakpoint.tablet (<768px) and show it at breakpoint.tablet/desktop (>=768px), reusing the AC-P4-01-41 breakpoint token rather than a new one. Drop the pill's previous fixed min-width below breakpoint.tablet so the icon-only state stays content-sized.
Keep aria-label="Scope switcher" on the trigger button at every breakpoint so the accessible name is breakpoint-independent.
Selecting a menu option (Self/Team) must behave exactly as A1 (refetch, teamView reset) and close the menu; the current scope is check-marked in the open menu.
Escape-to-close on the anchored menu: extracted a shared useEscapeKey hook in src/headless/index.tsx (used by both Layer and MenuPopover) rather than duplicating a keydown listener.

Add/verify Playwright tests named after AC-P4-01-42 in tests/e2e/personas.spec.ts (mobile: icon+chevron only, .scope-pill-label not visible, menu click still refetches) and tests/e2e/performance-desktop.spec.ts (desktop: .scope-pill-label visible with text 'Self').

openQuestions: icon.insights.scope-avatar (Remix user-line) remains an unapproved placeholder pending a Figma-exported avatar asset from UX (README §7 OQ-24); replacing the icon file only requires no VM/prop change.
